title: Scaling mistakes

captions.instagram:
Six ways chains break: growing faster than training, losing brand consistency, ignoring local markets, signing leases without a clear exit, letting suppliers slide, and skipping measurement.

The way I see it, most come down to the same fix: train, standardize, measure, repeat.

Save the red-flag check.

#Scaling #SmallBusiness #Operations

Which mistake have you seen most?
captions.facebook:
Growth breaks businesses in predictable ways. I listed six and a red-flag check to catch them early.

#Scaling #SmallBusiness

captions.linkedin:
Fix the system, not the symptom.

The scaling mistakes I'd watch for: growing faster than training, losing brand consistency, ignoring local markets, signing leases without a clear exit, letting supplier relationships slide, and skipping measurement.

Most are solved by the same four moves: train, standardize, measure, repeat.

#Scaling #Operations

Which mistake is hardest to see while it's happening?
